headlines.title: Woman With Breast Cancer at 26 Had to Pay $20,000 Out of Pocket for Care Due to Insurance Issues
headlines.description: Iris Di Cesare speaks to TODAY.com about receiving her breast cancer diagnosis and the financial burden it became when she unexpectedly lost her real estate job.

headlines.title: ‘Tea With Omar’: College Student Finds Comfort in Tea Ceremonies. Here Are Tips for the Perfect Cup
headlines.description: Omar Hernandez-Tena, who goes by “Tea With Omar” on TikTok, is a Brown University junior who loves Chinese tea culture, particularly gongfu cha (tea with skill).

headlines.title: RFK Jr. to roll out $10 million challenge to encourage Presidential Fitness Test in schools
headlines.description: Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. plans to announce a nationwide competition for schools aimed at expanding participation in the Presidential Fitness Test.

headlines.title: Amanda Peet on ‘Your Friends & Neighbors,’ Family, Cancer Battle
headlines.description: Actor Amanda Peet joins TODAY’s Jenna Bush Hager and Sheinelle Jones to chat about Season Three “Your Friends & Neighbors,” who her celebrity crush is, learning slang from her kids and parenting teens. Then, they are joined by Dr. Keith Flaherty, president of the American Associate for Cancer Research, to discuss her experience with breast cancer and share advancements in research and treatment.

headlines.title: Start TODAY’s October Challenge: Routine Revamp, Healthy Meals
headlines.description: October is the perfect time to revamp your routines, so fitness contributor Stephanie Mansour stops by Studio 1A to break down some easy Start TODAY workouts, which can be accessed for free on the app this month. TODAY nutrition and health expert Joy Bauer also shares some simple meals, including a French toast grilled cheese, cottage cheese fettuccine alfredo, pumpkin peanut butter, and more!

headlines.title: Jill Martin Shares Message to Her Past Self About Cancer Journey
headlines.description: TODAY lifestyle and commerce contributor Jill Martin and Dr. Elisa Port, chief breast cancer surgeon at Mount Sinai hospital in New York, stop by Studio 1A as part of Breast Cancer Awareness Month. Jill reflects on her journey with breast cancer and shares what she would tell her past self, saying, “Hang in there Jill, you’re becoming the woman your younger self would run to.” Then, Dr. Port breaks down the importance of early detection and getting screened regularly.

headlines.title: Amanda Peet Opens up About Breast Cancer Journey on TODAY
headlines.description: Actor and breast cancer survivor Amanda Peet sits down with TODAY’s Savannah Guthrie to share an update on her inspiring journey and open up about navigating the loss of both of her parents. Peet also reflects on her cancer diagnosis, talks about how she stayed in good spirits during treatment and shares words of encouragement for others facing cancer.

headlines.title: 4 things to buy, and 7 to skip, during October Prime Day
headlines.description: Before Prime Big Deal Days starts on October 6, shopping experts are breaking down what to buy vs. skip. Plus, learn strategies to save the most money.

headlines.title: Target Circle Membership: How to sign up and get the best deals and benefits
headlines.description: For access to the best deals during the Target Circle Deal Days sale, you need a Target Circle membership. These are the benefits, prices and details to know.

headlines.title: The best candle warmers for all the home fragrance without the flame
headlines.description: We spoke with experts about how to use a candle warmer as a safer alternative to an open flame. Shop candle warmer lamps with auto shut-off and dimmable features.

headlines.title: Target, Walmart, Best Buy and more stores have pre-Prime Day sales with up to 75% off
headlines.description: The strongest fall deals from Walmart, Target, Best Buy and other retailers, all vetted by NBC Selected editors.

headlines.title: Amanda Peet Reveals First ‘Weird’ Sign of Breast Cancer. It Wasn’t a Lump
headlines.description: Amanda Peet had an early breast cancer warning sign six months before she was diagnosed. She reveals the skin symptom that she calls “weird.” It wasn’t a lump.
